title: Debts
description: Receivables and payables you track by hand — pick an account to have its balance follow, or don't record in an account for something that predates the app
writeOffConfirmBody: Payments already recorded stay in the history. The debt can no longer be changed.
emptyBody: Add your first receivable or payable.
accountHelper: Which account did the money go through? Its balance updates to match.
paymentDeleteConfirmLinked: The transaction recorded in the account is removed too, and the account balance updates.
paymentDeleteConfirmPlain: The payment is removed from the history and what is still owed is recalculated.
paymentEditLinkedNote: The transaction recorded in the account is updated to match.
linkDescription: Records this debt's money in the account you choose, so the account balance matches what really happened.
linkIncludePayments: {count, plural, one {Also record the # existing payment} other {Also record the # existing payments}}
linkIncludePaymentsHelper: Each payment is recorded on its own date. Payments already recorded in an account are left as they are.
linkNoAccounts: You have no active {currency} account yet — add one first.
